definitions.gloss: friendly relations; fellowship; cordiality; getting to know each other
definitions.explanation: Warm, cordial interaction aimed at building personal connections. Most commonly seen in compound forms like {懇親会|こんしんかい} (social gathering).

examples.japanese: ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
{懇親|こんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食事会|しょくじかい}→食事会：23547_shokujikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We held a dinner party to deepen our friendly relations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧どうし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懇親|こんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられた→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: After the academic conference, an opportunity was set up for attendees to build friendly connections.

notes:
Most frequently encountered in the compound ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧ (social gathering, mixer), which is a standard event in Japanese business, academic, and organizational life. These gatherings typically involve food and drinks and are designed for networking and relationship-building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧: social gathering, mixer, reception
- {懇親|こんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}める→深める：02407_fukameru⟧: to deepen friendly relations
- {懇親|こんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to promote fellowship
- {懇親|こんしん}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧: friendship party

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{親睦|しんぼく}→親睦：09128_shinboku⟧: friendship, amity — very similar meaning; often interchangeable (⟦{親睦会|しんぼくかい}→親睦会：14968_shinbokukai⟧ is nearly synonymous with ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧)
- ⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧: exchange, interaction — broader and more neutral; covers cultural, academic, and international exchanges

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in business, academic, and organizational contexts. Not typically used in casual conversation.
